machine.text: Umarni na iya gudana a wannan kwamfutar ma, da shirye-shiryenta da sabobinta: buɗe tashar umarni a ɗaya daga cikin fayilolin ajiyarka ka liƙa wannan layin. Sai ɗawainiyoyin da ke da wannan fayil ɗin ajiya su gudanar da umarninsu a can, har sai ka danna Ctrl+C a wannan tashar umarnin.
machine.on: Ɗawainiyoyin da ke da fayil ɗin ajiya {folder} suna gudanar da umarninsu a wannan kwamfutar, ana tambaya kafin kowanne, har sai ka danna Ctrl+C a tashar umarninsa.
machine.question: A gudanar da wannan a kwamfutarka, a {folder}?
